conviction_note: Q3 comes out at about 19:00 CEST on 20 Oct, after the Xetra close, so the window that holds the reaction is the close of 20 Oct to the close of 21 Oct. Eurex's published Q3 volumes (+28% YoY, September +45%) suggest financial derivatives revenue may beat the company-compiled consensus a little. But 14 analysts already sit above guidance on every line, the stock has run with its sector (+11% in 20 days, alongside Euronext, LSEG and CME), and recent beats here were met with flat tapes. So the lean is slight (p_up 53) on a 3% move. The findings sum (+0.2) and the scaled number (+0.18) roughly agree.

findings.finding: Eurex's published Q3 2026 volumes (IR derivatives 343.8m vs 246.8m, +39%; index 154.7m vs 146.3m, +6%; equity 79.5m vs 59.9m, +33%; OTC notional outstanding average ~57tn vs ~45tn; repo +24-58%) put Financial Derivatives net revenue around 350-365m on a crude fee-mix fit to Q3/25 (275), Q2/25 (316) and Q2/26 (362). The consensus mean is 339 (range 319-357), and some of those estimates were dated before the September figures (+45%) came out on 7 Oct.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q2/26 Financial Derivatives rose to 362 and EBITDA beat. The stock fell almost 3% intraday on 23 Jul, then closed flat (+0.5%/-0.2%). Q1/26 (record EBITDA) +0.3% the next day. Beats on volume lines have been met with small moves.
findings.why_not_priced: Only partly unpriced. The consensus window (25 Sep-12 Oct) straddles the 7 Oct September release, and the 319 minimum shows that at least some estimates are stale. Against that, the stock rose 7% after 5 Oct along with Euronext (+8.5%), LSEG (+6%) and CME (+6%), so the volume story is visibly in the sector price. If it were fully priced, the consensus range for Financial Derivatives would have narrowed toward 350+.
findings.independence: Q2/26 half-year report: Financial Derivatives 362 on Q2 volumes, with pricing changes lifting the average fee per contract. https://www.deutsche-boerse.com/resource/blob/5302530/683d446f9d49b88f194990b24a79aee8/data/gdb-quarterly-statement-q2-2026_en.pdf

findings.finding: Analysts already sit above company guidance on every FY26 line: net revenue 6,588 vs >6,400, treasury 825 vs >700, EBITDA 3,955 vs >3,800, implied ex-treasury net revenue ~5,763 vs ~5,700. A guidance raise is the bar, not upside, and a reiteration of 'around 5.7bn ex-treasury' would land below it.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The Q2/26 treasury raise to >0.7bn produced a flat close (-0.2% next day) after an initial -3%. The raise was read as a treasury-only move with the core guide merely confirmed.
findings.why_not_priced: This finding is the bar, not news. The negative tail exists because the price (record high, near the 318 mean target) implies a raise. If a non-raise were priced, the stock would not be trading at 98% of the consensus target.
findings.independence: Q2/26 statement, where the ex-treasury guide was only confirmed: https://deutsche-boerse.com/dbg-en/media/news-stories/press-releases/Q2-2026-Broad-Based-Secular-Growth-and-Operating-Leverage-in-the-Second-Quarter-5397468

findings.why_not_priced: The series is public and only one month of three was read, so this is mostly priced. It is a small segment (~10% of revenue) and a repost rather than the EEX original.

baseline_tension: The volume evidence leans mildly positive, against a priced lean of -0.57 that is just the run-up term. The +11% run-up was sector-wide (Euronext, LSEG, CME all up 6-9%), which suggests the volume story is largely priced. That is why p_up sits only 3 points above 50.

lessons_applied: 'A number the market has already been told is worth 0': the Eurex volumes are public monthly, so the derivatives finding went from +0.6 to +0.4 and the Clearstream finding from +0.1 to 0.0
'The move is in the guide' and 'too small about the move': a guidance raise is likely, so abs_move_pct went from 2.5 to 3.0 despite the name's low volatility (median next-day reaction ~1.4%)
'Coverage tells you which regime' (>13 analysts) plus muted reactions to past beats: p_up went from 54 to 53 and print_vs_bar_pct from 1.5 to 1.2
The EEX finding was trimmed from 0.15 to 0.1 as a single-month repost proxy
